derivation: a primitive root (rather identical with H6148 (עָרַב) through the idea of close association);
kjv: be pleasant(-ing), take pleasure in, be sweet.

words.word: with whom thou hast taken pleasure

occurrences.text: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the Lord.
The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.

Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
words: with whom thou hast taken pleasure

occurrences.text: They shall not offer wine offerings to the Lord, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the Lord.
Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the Lord, as in the days of old, and as in former years.
